run_quantize_model: run auto_round to quantize a HuggingFace model using W4A16 scheme and save to output directory
run_eval_quantized_model: run evaluation on a quantized model using lm_eval harness tasks like mmlu and wikitext
run_quantize_best_recipe: run auto_round quantization with the best recipe using 1000 iterations and 512 calibration samples
run_quantize_fast_recipe: run auto_round quantization with the fast recipe using 200 iterations and 512 sequence length
list_supported_formats: list all supported output formats and quantization schemes using the auto_round list format command
